params.1273: Create an amulet of strength, performing each step in Lumbridge.
params.1274: You must perform each of the following steps in Lumbridge to complete this Task:
params.1275: Smelt gold ore into a bar, cut the ruby, craft a ruby amulet.
params.1276: Shear a sheep, spin the wool, string the amulet.
params.1292: This Hard Task is part of the Lumbridge set.
